assertions.assertion: The appeal contests the medical necessity denial (CO-22)
The denial reason code is CO-22
The appeal is for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229)

The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to optimize rate control management
